what: OPERATOR DECISION (W6-P3 automation spec, option D): authorise the READ-ONLY feasibility probe for driving breakout_1's DXtrade account from our VM. Step 0 is a documented DXtrade REST login plus one read (this is option C). Steps 1-2 are a Playwright read-only login and a 72h session keep-alive. It needs BREAKOUT_DX_USERNAME/PASSWORD/DOMAIN as Actions secrets, which the operator originates, and a Tier-2 secret sync to the VM. No order-placing code is involved; that is a later held Tier-2 PR. -- UPDATE 2026-09-27 ~10:05Z (session_01Ddb4V5PQhti4j4R6fQk6Ds): (a) The probe design CHANGED. The operator corrected the platform: they believe breakout_1 is on the proprietary Breakout Terminal, not DXtrade. First-party sources cannot settle it per account. Breakout's DXtrade white-label is itself titled 'Breakout Terminal' (MEASURED: curl https://wss.breakoutprop.com/ returned 200, <title>Breakout Terminal</title>, TOTP issuer dxTrade5). The old step 0, a DXtrade REST login, is DROPPED: /dxsca-web/ returns '403 RBAC: access denied' before auth. NEW step 0 = one operator answer: does breakout_1 open via dashboard 'Open Terminal' (portal.breakoutprop.com, proprietary) or via app.breakoutprop.com (DXtrade)? Spec section 'Which platform' and D.6 in docs/research/prop-automation-options-2026-09-27.md. (b) AUTHORISATION: the operator pre-authorised a READ-ONLY probe by popup ~09:42Z, CONDITIONAL on the platform being established from first-party sources first. That condition is NOT met, so no probe code has been written. (c) SECRETS, names only, never values in chat or PRs; they go in GitHub Actions secrets and then the existing sync-vm-secrets route. DXtrade branch: BREAKOUT_DX_USERNAME, BREAKOUT_DX_PASSWORD, plus BREAKOUT_DX_TOTP_SEED only if 2FA is on. Proprietary branch: BREAKOUT_PORTAL_EMAIL, BREAKOUT_PORTAL_PASSWORD, plus BREAKOUT_PORTAL_TOTP_SEED only if authenticator 2FA exists; an emailed code on every login makes that branch infeasible. (d) Next: the manager asks the operator the step-0 question and records the answer here; then this lane builds the Tier-2 held read-only probe PR for that platform.
